title_zh: 把合作咖啡馆理念落实为开业接待安排

scenario.label_zh: 把合作咖啡馆理念落实为开业接待安排
scenario.goal_zh: 讨论合作咖啡馆希望体现的平等交流，并约定设置共用桌和轮流迎宾

context_zh: 一家由员工共同经营的咖啡馆开业前，两名成员安排迎宾。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Lottie
sentences.text: People keep asking whether this will be a formal establishment with reserved tables and a host at the door.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: I hope not. We want the cafe to embody the idea that neighbours can sit down and talk as equals.

sentences.speaker: Lottie
sentences.text: Then let us use the long shared table rather than setting every table for separate groups.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: Agreed, but leave the small tables too. Not everyone will want company.

sentences.speaker: Lottie
sentences.text: Who should welcome people on opening day?

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: We can take turns instead of having one person act as the owner. That reflects how we run the place together.

sentences.speaker: Lottie
sentences.text: Good. I will set up the shared table and keep the smaller ones. You take the first welcome shift, and I will take the second.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: That works. Let us put those two shifts on the rota.
